blogs.title: Semaglutide and the Silent Muscle Killer: A New Face of Drug-Induced Myopathy?
blogs.description: This post analyzes the unique clinical trajectory of this case, distinguishing it from classic GLP-1 induced rhabdomyolysis. We explore why this patient's CK levels rose progressively over four months *after* a single dose, contrasting the delayed onset and severity of this immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy (IMNM) against the rapid resolution typically seen in direct toxic myopathies.

blogs.title: The Seronegative Dilemma: Diagnosing IMNM When Antibodies Are Missing
blogs.description: Focusing on the diagnostic challenge presented here, this article discusses how to approach suspected IMNM when standard panels for anti-HMGCR and anti-SRP are negative. We break down the critical role of muscle biopsy morphology (necrosis with paucity of lymphocytes vs. macrophage infiltration) and how to interpret 'seronegative' results in the context of a clear temporal drug trigger.

blogs.title: Beyond the GI Complaints: Recognizing Systemic Red Flags in GLP-1 Users
blogs.description: While nausea and vomiting are common side effects, this post highlights the danger signs that should prompt early investigation for neuromuscular toxicity. We discuss the subtle progression from acute dehydration-induced AKI to profound proximal weakness, dysphagia, and dysphonia, emphasizing when to order CK levels in patients on weight-loss agents presenting with 'unexplained' fatigue or falls.

blogs.title: The Cardiac Connection: Incidental Myocarditis or Stress Cardiomyopathy in Severe Myopathy?
blogs.description: This entry delves into the cardiac findings (elevated troponin/proBNP, LV hypokinesis) observed in this patient. We weigh the differential between true autoimmune myocarditis co-occurring with IMNM versus stress-induced (Takotsubo-like) cardiomyopathy triggered by severe systemic illness, offering guidance on monitoring cardiac biomarkers in patients with severe inflammatory myopathies.
